room5_d6_r10_loc: Okay. But if Alex doesn't want to talk to you, you get out of here immediately!
room5_d6_r1_loc: Well hello, dear. Did you miss me?
room5_d6_r2_loc: Victor? How are you... What are you doing here?
room5_d6_r3_loc: I came to pick up my son, of course. It is not good to separate him from his beloved dad.
room5_d6_r4_loc: It seems that we have already decided everything, Victor. You take everything but leave me and Alex alone!
room5_d6_r5_loc: I'm afraid the situation has changed a little. I want to see Alex, and you have no right to interfere with me.
room5_d6_r6_loc: I still have it, but I...
room5_d6_r7_loc: Anna. Calmly. Let's mind our own business. I'll call Alex and he'll figure it out himself. Please trust me.
room5_d6_r9_loc: That's it, listen to this hard worker. Otherwise it will be worse!
room5_d7_r1_loc: How long do I still have to wait? I'm tired of breathing dust. I hate this place.
room5_d7_r3_loc: Well, finally! So I came for you, as promised. Let's go, I'll ride with the breeze.
room5_d7_r6_loc: Dad... I don't want to leave. I'll stay here with mom!
room5_d7_r7_loc: What? You said it was boring here. And your whole life remained there: friends, toys, console.
room5_d7_r8_loc: Yes, dad. But here's mom. And she is dearer to me than all this! And in general I like it here!
room5_d8_r10_loc: Outrageous! What are you saying? Who screwed up my boy? Again you are with your...
room5_d8_r11_loc: I think it's best for you, Mister, to leave. And if you continue to offend Anna, I will have to use force.
room5_d8_r12_loc: Okay. But I’ll come back and we’ll talk completely differently, big guy.
room5_d9_r1_loc: How cozy it is here now! Just like home, even better.
room5_d9_r2_loc: Son... I'm glad you didn't go with him... I was very afraid...
room5_d9_r3_loc: Mom. Well, where will I go without you? Without Sherlock and... new friends... In general, it’s not so sad here.
room5_d9_r4_loc: Maybe there will be more. We'll teach you how to saw and plan! Then you definitely won't get bored.
room5_d9_r5_loc: Oh, I completely forgot. Maybe this sign will help you read your dad's book?
room5_d9_r6_loc: It's like in spy movies! You need to put the table on a piece of paper and it will highlight the correct letters.
room5_d9_r8_loc: “I will leave something very valuable for you in our house, Anya. I hope it will help you in difficult times. Forgive me for everything. Dad.”
room5_d9_r9_loc: It looks like there are still many secrets in this house...
room6_d10_r1_loc: Finally... It was hard and I couldn't have done it without you guys!
room6_d10_r2_loc: I don't know how to thank you for all this, Henry. It's better here than it was!
room6_d10_r3_loc: Now guys, you can play here with Sherlock
room6_d10_r4_loc: Hey. on the tree! There are some people here, looking for Anya!
room6_d10_r6_loc: I'm not sure what it is, but it seems like I should still call Arthur.
room6_d10_r7_loc: No really. I'll figure it out myself!
room6_d1_r1_loc: Honey, I'm so glad you stayed. I want to show you something interesting
room6_d1_r2_loc: Tree house? You said you can’t come here, it’s very high!
room6_d1_r3_loc: You know, when I was little, my friend and I had a refuge here.
room6_d1_r4_loc: And I thought that you wouldn’t mind having your own headquarters either. Just need to tidy up.
room6_d2_r3_loc: What are you doing! I wanted to say that my friend called. Her granddaughter is going to visit us.
room6_d2_r4_loc: How lovely. You can show her your headquarters.
room6_d2_r5_loc: But there's nothing here! Only dust and dirt.
room6_d2_r6_loc: Don't worry, we'll make it before she arrives!
room6_d3_r1_loc: What a cool telescope. Dad promised to buy one, but he didn’t...
room6_d3_r2_loc: Don't worry, we'll fix it and put it here.
room6_d3_r3_loc: My father loved to show me the stars. He said there was someone...
room6_d3_r4_loc: Oh, what is this? Son, take a look.
room6_d3_r5_loc: Someone ruined it. Scratched this what's-her-name... Lens.
room6_d3_r6_loc: The dial was scratched here. This is very strange. Maybe daddy's message again?
room6_d4_r2_loc: Sherlock! How did you get here? Do you want to help?
room6_d4_r3_loc: Maybe you can find something from grandpa?
room6_d4_r5_loc: It’s as if we didn’t have to look for this detective.
room6_d4_r6_loc: Look after him please, there's not much left here
room6_d5_r1_loc: Hello everyone! Wow, Sherlock is here too
room6_d5_r3_loc: Well, it's time to decorate this house!
room6_d5_r4_loc: Thank you Uncle Henry! Just hurry up, please, I'm waiting for guests!
room6_d5_r5_loc: Climbing here, of course, is another adventure. But I'll try to bring everything I need.
room6_d5_r6_loc: Just be careful, it's really high up here!
room6_d6_r3_loc: Mom, we won't make it in time! Alice will be here soon!
room6_d6_r4_loc: Honey, I understand, but it's very difficult for Henry to carry all this here.
room6_d6_r5_loc: Don’t worry, Anya, I can handle it! I'll take a break and get back to work.
room6_d7_r1_loc: Hello everyone! Hi Alex, hi Alex's mom, hi Henry!
room6_d7_r3_loc: And I got up early and already managed to pick mushrooms and berries.
room6_d7_r5_loc: Thank you! However, we did not have time to prepare everything.
room6_d7_r6_loc: Uncle Henry found it very difficult to work at heights.
room6_d8_r1_loc: How's it going? Everything is fine, I hope?
room6_d8_r2_loc: Anya, don't worry. I pull the rope up, the youth belays.
room6_d8_r3_loc: Alice is also great at tying knots. At least now I definitely won’t fall.
room6_d8_r4_loc: Wonderful! I'm glad they help you so much!
room6_d8_r5_loc: I agree. Still, let's get this over with quickly.
room6_d9_r2_loc: Oh Sherlock, I forgot you were here.
room6_d9_r3_loc: You are my good one! Come here!
room6_d9_r5_loc: Is this where you always run away? Not Sherlock, but some kind of Moriarty.
room6_d9_r6_loc: He's just looking for clues. Helps me and my mom with the investigation!
room6_d9_r7_loc: How interesting! What kind of investigation?
room6_d9_r8_loc: Honey, let's not talk about this for now...
room6_old_secret_floor_hatch_loc: old secret hatch in the floor
room7_d1_r1_loc: How long will it take to wait for them? What irresponsibility!
room7_d1_r2_loc: I agree, Mr. Miller, and how can such a person raise a child?
room7_d1_r3_loc: Good afternoon! I'm sorry, we're undergoing renovations...
room7_d1_r4_loc: Noticeable... Thomas Miller, I represent the guardianship authorities. Your husband said...
room7_d1_r5_loc: Oh, I can imagine what he could tell you! If you knew how deceitful this man is...
room7_d1_r6_loc: However, the information seems very true.
room7_d1_r7_loc: Mrs. Morgan said the house was in a terrible state, which is what I observe.
room7_d1_r8_loc: What are you doing! Just needs a little tidying up!
room7_d2_r2_loc: Here comes young Mr. Winters. You and I have a lot to discuss.
room7_d2_r3_loc: You want to take me away from my mother, right?
room7_d2_r4_loc: I came to find out what conditions you live in. And I’m still very depressed.
room7_d2_r5_loc: Don't even think about taking Alex! We're doing great!
room7_d2_r6_loc: Now we will help Alex’s mother, and it will become even better!
room7_d3_r1_loc: Alex, you’ve always loved video games, hanging out with friends, what do you do?
room7_d3_r2_loc: Anna, what kind of child labor is this?
room7_d3_r3_loc: Come on, Miss Morgan, children need to be taught order.
room7_d3_r4_loc: This is what they do in... the establishments that I represent.
room7_d3_r5_loc: I hope it doesn't come to that.
room7_d4_r1_loc: Now it's a completely different matter, isn't it?
room7_d4_r2_loc: Indeed. But conditions are still depressing.
room7_d4_r4_loc: Don't worry, we're all here in an instant... how's that? Let's ennoble!
room7_d4_r6_loc: Henry. I'm Anna's friend. And I'm responsible for making this place shine again!
room7_d5_r1_loc: I didn't think Victor would send you, Claire. We got along well with you.
room7_d5_r2_loc: I didn’t think you’d arrange something like this either, Anya.
room7_d5_r3_loc: And what is it like for Alex now? The child has his whole life left there!
room7_d5_r4_loc: You don't understand! Victor has messed with your brain too!
room7_d5_r6_loc: Control yourself, Mrs. Winters, or I'll have to take action.
room7_d6_r1_loc: How long do I have to watch this circus? It seems that everything is quite clear here...
room7_d6_r2_loc: Hello, hello. Mrs. Wallace, neighbor of this wonderful family.
room7_d6_r3_loc: And you, I assume, are from the guardianship? Oh, I'm very glad that you have finally arrived!
room7_d6_r5_loc: You know, Victor came not long ago. He shouted so much at poor Anya!
room7_d6_r6_loc: Terrible person. I also told her father that he shouldn’t let his daughter go to him!
room7_d6_r7_loc: Interesting information. I have a completely different one.
room7_d6_r8_loc: Come on, I’ll tell you everything about this rogue.
room7_d6_r9_loc: In the meantime, the guys will finish the repairs.
room7_d7_r1_loc: Well, you can appreciate how everything has changed!
room7_d7_r2_loc: Very beautiful, mom! I'm glad it helped you!
room7_d7_r4_loc: Indeed, it looks quite decent. And you did it quickly.
room7_d7_r5_loc: I'm afraid it's time for me to leave. Overall, we need to study the situation better.
room7_d7_r6_loc: Let us come to you this week with a full commission.
room7_d7_r7_loc: If the house has not been restored by the time we arrive... You understand.
